name: Alexey Kuznetsov
org: Institute for Nuclear Research (INR), Russian Academy of Sciences (kuznet@ms2.inr.ac.ru)
why_notable: Original author of iproute2 (the ip and tc commands). He was responsible for the quality-of-service implementation in the Linux kernel, which is why traffic control lives in the same package as ip, and he co-authored RFC 3549, 'Linux Netlink as an IP Services Protocol' (2003), the document that formalised the netlink interface ip uses to talk to the kernel. His name is also on the kernel's own routing documentation. iproute2's CREDITS file lists him as original author, while Stephen Hemminger took the project over starting with the 2.6 kernel.
